record.question: Who authored the book ‘Harry Potter and Deathly Hallow”
record.explanation: The publisher credits J. K. Rowling. The printed title lacks the and plural Hallows, but uniquely identifies the book. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.bloomsbury.com/uk/harry-potter-and-the-deathly-hallows-9781408855713/ Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
